summary: Implemented the rich.progress open and wrap_file feature. Changes: rich/progress.py (private reader _ProgressFileReader, context wrapper _ReaderContext, _file_progress helper, module-level open and wrap_file with overloads, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file with overloads); tests/test_progress.py (14 new tests before the script-entry block); docs/source/progress.rst (two new subsections under Advanced usage); CHANGELOG.md (one Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 1759). Nothing was run: tests, black, isort, and mypy are unverified, per the instruction not to run repository code. Nothing was committed. Open risk: on Python 3.6, typing.IO may carry abstract mode and name properties, which could make the reader fail to instantiate there; this needs a run on 3.6 to confirm. Suppressions added: readline (override), readinto (no-untyped-def, override), and the handle readinto call (attr-defined). No return-value or type-var suppression was added, because the context wrapper subclasses AbstractContextManager.
